description: A Long Island cover band formed in 2017 that plays as a trio up to a six-piece, mixing classic rock, country, Motown, R&B, Top 40 and some disco.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). A different 'Mach 5' rock band is in Austin, TX (mach5atx.com). Tiki Joe's Captree gig not confirmed on the band site. Social links not found on the site.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Phone and email are the founder Sonny's, but the band's own site publishes them specifically for booking ('call Sonny to book us'), so they are recorded; the owner may prefer to show only the contact page. The 'logo' file is a PNG served by Wix for the home-page banner image (the URL ends in .jpg but the host returned PNG). The site mentions a YouTube channel but does not link it, and no Instagram was found. Gallery images 'concert crowd' and 'dark stage' on the home page look like stock photos and were skipped. The Tiki Joe's Captree gig from Ira's List still could not be confirmed on the band's site or in search.
